name: MD 900 Explorer
summary: A twin-turbine NOTAR helicopter with a five-blade rotor and no tail rotor, widely used for EMS and police work.

engines: Twin turboshafts under a hump behind the cabin
Exhausts on top at the rear
fuselage: Rounded pod with a large glass nose
tail: NOTAR smooth boom with no tail rotor
Twin vertical fins at the boom end

tellTales: No tail rotor: smooth boom with twin fins
Five-blade rotor over a twin-engine pod

confusedWith.howToTell: The 600N has a single engine and six blades; the MD 900 has twin engines and five blades.
The MD 500 has a conventional tail rotor and a smaller egg-shaped body; the MD 900 is larger with a NOTAR boom.
The 429 has a conventional tail rotor and four blades; the MD 900 has a NOTAR boom and five blades.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
